name: Admin Document Title Column Resize
description: Read long document names without opening them in /panel/documents. In both the table and card gallery, titles are contained on one ellipsized line; when clipped, the complete text is available through a native hint and the same in-place Ver completo/Contraer control, whose expanded state wraps even unbroken names. Folder and accompanying distinctions render in ordered metadata below the title without reserving a blank desktop line for documents without a folder. In list mode, the Título header exposes a keyboard-accessible drag separator that resizes from 240px to 520px, starts at 320px, persists the chosen width in projectapp-table-widths:documents-list, and resets on double-click. Proyecto, Cliente and Fecha yield space in that order, while Estados and Acciones remain fixed and the table scrolls internally after donor floors are reached.
